messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

You will be given a piece of text and a list of relational triples in the format of [Subject, Relation, Object] extracted from the text. For each relation present in the triples, your task is to write a description to express the meaning of the relation.

Here are some examples:
Example 1:
Text: Lipitor (atorvastatin) belongs to a group of drugs called statins. Lipitor is used together with diet to lower blood levels of "bad" cholesterol (LDL) and to reduce the risk of stroke and heart attack.
Triples: [["Lipitor", "has generic name", "atorvastatin"], ["Lipitor", "belongs to drug class", "statins"], ["Lipitor", "treats", "high LDL cholesterol"], ["Lipitor", "reduces risk of", "stroke"]]
Relations: ["has generic name", "belongs to drug class", "treats", "reduces risk of"]
Answer:
has generic name: The subject drug is known by the generic (non-proprietary) name specified by the object entity.
belongs to drug class: The subject drug is a member of the pharmacological drug class specified by the object entity.
treats: The subject drug is used to treat or manage the medical condition specified by the object entity.
reduces risk of: The subject drug is used to lower the risk of the medical event or condition specified by the object entity.

Example 2:
Text: You should not use metformin if you have severe kidney disease. Tell your doctor if you have ever had liver disease. Metformin may cause lactic acidosis, a serious condition. Avoid drinking alcohol while taking metformin.
Triples: [["metformin", "contraindicated in", "severe kidney disease"], ["metformin", "use with caution in", "liver disease"], ["metformin", "has serious side effect", "lactic acidosis"], ["metformin", "should be avoided with", "alcohol"]]
Relations: ["contraindicated in", "use with caution in", "has serious side effect", "should be avoided with"]
Answer:
contraindicated in: The subject drug should not be used by patients who have the condition specified by the object entity.
use with caution in: The subject drug may be unsafe or require medical supervision for patients who have the condition specified by the object entity.
has serious side effect: The subject drug may cause the serious or dangerous adverse effect specified by the object entity.
should be avoided with: Patients taking the subject drug should avoid the substance or activity specified by the object entity.

Example 3:
Text: Amlodipine is available as oral tablets in strengths of 2.5 mg, 5 mg, and 10 mg. Overdose symptoms may include rapid heartbeats and fainting. Norvasc is made by Pfizer.
Triples: [["amlodipine", "has dosage form", "oral tablet"], ["amlodipine", "has strength", "2.5 mg"], ["amlodipine", "has overdose symptom", "fainting"], ["Norvasc", "manufactured by", "Pfizer"]]
Relations: ["has dosage form", "has strength", "has overdose symptom", "manufactured by"]
Answer:
has dosage form: The subject drug is available in the pharmaceutical dosage form specified by the object entity.
has strength: The subject drug is available in the dose strength specified by the object entity.
has overdose symptom: An overdose of the subject drug may cause the symptom specified by the object entity.
manufactured by: The subject drug is manufactured or marketed by the company specified by the object entity.

Now please write relation descriptions given the following text and triples. Note that the description needs to be general and can be used to describe relations between other entities as well. Pay attention to the order of subject and object entities. Write exactly one line per relation in the form "relation: description" and nothing else.
Text: Tell your doctor and pharmacist what prescription and over-the-counter medications, vitamins, nutritional supplements, and herbal products you are planning to take or are taking. They may interact with tirzepatide, and your doctor may need to change the doses of your medications or monitor you carefully for side effects.
Birth control pills may not work as well while receiving this medicine. Your doctor may suggest you use another form of birth control for 4 weeks after starting tirzepatide and for 4 weeks after each dose change.
Taking tirzepatide with other medicines to treat diabetes, such as sulfonylureas or insulin, may increase your risk of hypoglycemia. Talk to your doctor and pharmacist about low blood sugar and how to manage it.
This medicine delays gastric emptying and may alter the absorption of other orally administered medicines.
This list is not complete. Many other drugs may interact with Mounjaro and Zepbound, including prescription and over-the-counter medicines, vitamins, and herbal products. To check for interactions with this medicine, click the link below.
Triples: [["tirzepatide", "interacts with", "prescription medications"], ["tirzepatide", "interacts with", "over-the-counter medications"], ["tirzepatide", "interacts with", "vitamins"], ["tirzepatide", "interacts with", "nutritional supplements"], ["tirzepatide", "interacts with", "herbal products"], ["tirzepatide", "may require dose adjustment", "other medications"], ["tirzepatide", "may require monitoring for", "side effects"], ["tirzepatide", "reduces effectiveness of", "birth control pills"], ["tirzepatide", "requires alternative birth control", "4 weeks after starting"], ["tirzepatide", "requires alternative birth control", "4 weeks after each dose change"], ["tirzepatide", "increases risk of", "hypoglycemia"], ["tirzepatide", "interacts with", "sulfonylureas"], ["tirzepatide", "interacts with", "insulin"], ["tirzepatide", "has mechanism of action", "delays gastric emptying"], ["tirzepatide", "alters absorption of", "orally administered medicines"], ["tirzepatide", "has incomplete interaction list", "other drugs"], ["tirzepatide", "interacts with", "mounjaro"], ["tirzepatide", "interacts with", "zepbound"], ["tirzepatide", "has interaction check link", "click the link below"]]
Relations: ["alters absorption of", "has incomplete interaction list", "has interaction check link", "has mechanism of action", "increases risk of", "interacts with", "may require dose adjustment", "may require monitoring for", "reduces effectiveness of", "requires alternative birth control"]
Answer:

completion:
alters absorption of: The subject drug changes the way the object entity is absorbed in the body.  
has incomplete interaction list: The subject drug has an incomplete list of drugs that may interact with it.  
has interaction check link: The subject drug has a link provided for checking interactions with other drugs.  
has mechanism of action: The subject drug functions through the mechanism described by the object entity.  
increases risk of: The subject drug increases the likelihood of the adverse event or condition specified by the object entity.  
interacts with: The subject drug may have a pharmacological interaction with the object entity.  
may require dose adjustment: The subject drug may necessitate a change in the dosage of the object entity.  
may require monitoring for: The subject drug may require close observation for the adverse effect or condition specified by the object entity.  
reduces effectiveness of: The subject drug decreases the efficacy of the object entity.  
requires alternative birth control: The subject drug necessitates the use of an alternative form of birth control for the time period specified by the object entity.
